|---|---|---|

| 2 | `ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN role SET DEFAULT 'hacker'` | **Escalate privileges** by changing default role |
| 3 | `DROP TABLE users CASCADE` | **Destroy** the entire users table and dependents |
| 4 | `--` | **Comment out** the rest of the legitimate query |
